summary: Members lapse when their card expires
description: Support kept seeing members lapse right after their card on file expired, before they'd had a chance to update payment details. Their renewal never even got a second attempt before the account fell over, which is the case for moving grace from 3 days out to 7.

comments.author: kasia.brandt
comments.body: For context, a failed renewal isn't something we have to poll for. Tollbooth Pay already fires a webhook at farebox the moment a membership renewal charge fails, so we know about it in real time.

comments.author: mara.voss
comments.body: Decision: grace moves to 7 days out from a failed renewal, up from the current 3. Kasia's opening a PR for it.
